audit.summary: Exact author manuscript reviewed in full. The core product-to-join proof uses false spaces and covers. Explicit finite topology and integral Tor calculations establish precise scope; natural replacement proof and actual freeness give counterevidence. Decision and independent acceptance remain pending.
limitations: False product-to-join endpoint, hemisphere cover and hemisphere contractibility in Lemma4.22 — Counterevidence: For this same example D2=D1 smash D1≈wedge4S4 agrees with Sigma3 K3,3. A natural quotient/join replacement can be constructed, and the cited GKRW single-factor lemma is valid; none makes the printed filtration correct.

Missing algebra flatness in ordinary-bar/absolute-Tor comparison — Counterevidence: Steinberg groups and relevant simplicial chain groups in the actual application are Z-free. Cited MPP1910.05574v3 Proposition2.33(ii), pp18–19, explicitly requires both algebraR_n and leftmoduleB_n free; actual pages inspected.

Rank-zero formulas conflict with the explicitly retained unit — Counterevidence: IntroThm1.5 alreadyrequiresn≥1 and thelaterfieldformulaSt0tensorSt0=Z is correct. No positive-rank connectivity theorem is refuted.
Reversed Boolean-poset order in the last Möbius inversion sum — Counterevidence: Definition2.24 and precedingrankdisplayhavecorrectsupersetdirection; direct general proof confirmsTheorem2.25.

Fixed U_A substituted for running U_T in the flag calculation — Counterevidence: Preceding andfollowingformulasarecorrect; independent adapted quotient-basis proof confirmsarbitraryfinite nonemptyflaglemma.

Nonzero splitting components omitted in the complex model — Counterevidence: Def3.5samepageexpresslyrequirespropernonzero components; latercomparisonproofusesintendedrestriction. SimplicialsetDef4.14intentionallyallowszeros.
Overstrong rank descriptions in the Morse filtration — Counterevidence: NeededboundrankW≤n-2holdsbecauseW<W+V0<M. Actualf(U)=<e2,e3>isG0, andgenerallyf(U)+V0=U+V0!=M.
